Id1.text: The album 1969: The Velvet Underground Live is preceded by the Velvet Underground album Squeeze, which was followed by The Quine Tapes.

Id2.text: The Velvet Underground album Bootleg Series Volume 1: The Quine Tapes was preceded by the album Squeeze, which was followed by the live album 1969: The Velvet Underground Live.

Id3.text: The Bootleg Series Volume I: The Quine Tapes is preceded by the Velvet Underground album Squeeze which was itself followed by the album 1969: The Velvet Underground Live.
